shadshiny: 'shadcn/ui' Components for 'Shiny'

Source: R/shadshiny-package.R
shadshiny-package.Rd

A complete port of the shadcn/ui design system for Shiny: 72 accessible, themeable components implemented in framework-free CSS and vanilla JavaScript, wrapped as native R functions with Shiny input bindings. It coexists with Bootstrap 5 and bslib, including automatic dark-mode synchronization.

Getting started

Wrap your UI in page_shad() to attach the asset bundle and theme scope, then use the shad_*() component constructors. Read bound values as input$<inputId> and update them from the server with the update_shad_*() helpers.

Load order & the uniform contract

All assets ship as a single bundled htmlDependency (shadshiny_deps()): one minified stylesheet and one minified script, built in a fixed order from tokens, base and animation CSS, then component CSS/JS, with the Shiny binding layer last. Set options(shadshiny.assets = "source") to load the per-component files instead when debugging the CSS or JS. Every stateful component root carries data-shad="<name>"; its JS instance exposes getValue()/setValue() (plus open()/close() for overlays) and dispatches a bubbling shad:change event that the generic Shiny input binding subscribes to.

Theming

Colours come from --shad-* OKLCH custom properties. Switch palette with shad_theme_preset() or the theme_preset argument of page_shad(), and at runtime with update_shad_theme(). Dark mode keys off both .dark and [data-bs-theme="dark"], so bslib::input_dark_mode() works with no glue.
